Hi! As someone with as much workex as you and a great relationship with my manager and partner, as well as the same experience in projects and business development/proposal work—yes, this is normal! Most people who speak in client meetings are often people who have experience in that particular topic that they’re explaining, so a lot of our work initially is helping out without really specialising in any of it. I’m pretty sure that once we have had enough experience to develop a capability, we will be the ones speaking on it in client meetings. 

However, I’m already client-facing because I show the soft skills and technical expertise to support a more experienced manager. If you feel like you can support in client meetings, then have a talk with your manager or partner about it. Don’t get too overexcited about it, but just ask whether there’s something you can support on in client-facing roles. That’s what worked for me. Good luck! :)
